title: Baham language
description: Trans–New Guinea language spoken in Indonesia
extract: Baham, also rendered Mbaham, is a Papuan language spoken by the Mbaham–Matta people of the Bomberai Peninsula in West Papua Province, Indonesia. It is closely related to the Iha language.
